description: Kommunales Abwasser - Kommunale Kläranlagen NRW is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. In Nordrhein-Westfalen werden Daten zu kommunalen Kläranlagen ab 50 EW Ausbaugröße von den zuständigen Wasserbehörden (Bezirksregierungen, untere Wasserbehörden) in der Datenbank ELKA (Einleiterkataster) erfasst. Es handelt sich um Stammdaten, Daten zur technischen Ausstattung der Kläranlagen sowie wasserrechtlich relevante Daten. Es sind z.B. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are abwasser, einleiterkataster, elka, elwas, kläranlagen. It offers 2 resource(s) in DOWNLOAD, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
